# Commands that formerly ignored surplus operands reject them as bad arguments.
! exec ./nlm_test refresh extra
stderr 'nlm: unexpected argument "extra" for "refresh"'
stderr 'exit-class=bad-args \(exit 2\)'

! exec ./nlm_test auth Work extra
stderr 'nlm: unexpected argument "extra" for "auth"'
stderr 'exit-class=bad-args \(exit 2\)'

! exec ./nlm_test chat config notebook goal default extra
stderr 'nlm: unexpected argument "extra" for "chat config"'
stderr 'exit-class=bad-args \(exit 2\)'

# Compatibility surfaces name the path the user typed.
! exec ./nlm_test chat-config notebook length default extra
stderr 'nlm: unexpected argument "extra" for "chat-config"'
stderr 'exit-class=bad-args \(exit 2\)'
